programme.title: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Brand new series: Alice and Sam Vanderpump nervously plan to tell Sam's aunt - the formidable Lisa Vanderpump - about their pregnancy. Jazz uncovers a shocking secret.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The Greek at the Harbor: Gordon Ramsay helps a family-run Greek restaurant turn its fortunes around in Ventura Harbor in California. But he uncovers a shocking family secret...

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: El Greco: Gordon Ramsay visits struggling Greek restaurant El Greco, where the owners have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3
programme.desc: (2018) Spooky animated family comedy. On a monster-friendly cruise, Dracula (Adam Sandler) falls in love - with a vampire slayer!

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of...
programme.desc: ...Unfortunate Events: (2004) Gothic family comedy starring Jim Carrey as the evil, scheming Count Olaf, who'll do whatever it takes to deprive three young orphans of their inheritance.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The First Pitch Insufficiency: Howard's nervous when NASA ask him to throw the first pitch at a baseball game. Sheldon claims his and Amy's relationship is the best in the gang.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Hook-Up Reverberation: Raj's honesty about his past comes back to haunt him when his girlfriend Emily gives Penny the cold shoulder. The guys consider an investment.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Focus Attenuation: The guys attempt to invent something of scientific importance but only come up with new and enjoyable ways to procrastinate.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Expedition Approximation: Sheldon and Raj try to find out if they could survive a dark-matter research expedition in a salt mine by simulating the conditions in a tunnel.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Jazzy and the Pussycats: Bart takes up playing the drums, upstages Lisa and joins a top jazz band. So Lisa turns her back on music and starts rescuing animals instead.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Please Homer Don't Hammer 'Em: Marge discovers that she has a gift for carpentry, but has to use Homer as a cover in order to overcome prejudices against women builders.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Treehouse of Horror XVII: Homer ingests a blob from an asteroid; Bart enslaves a clay monster; and everyone thinks that aliens are invading.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt): Homer accidentally signs up for basic training in the army. And Marge and Grampa get roped in when they try to get him released.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: Blonde Fist
programme.desc: 1991. Drama. Director: Frank Clarke. Stars Margi Clarke, Carroll Baker & Ken Hutchison. Ronnie flees domestic life to find her father in New York and ends up boxing to make ends meet.

programme.title: Black Velvet Band
programme.desc: 1997. Drama. Director: Robert Knights. Stars Nick Berry, Todd Carty & Chris McHallem. A failed attempt to steal the crown jewels lands a band of crooks on a ship to Australia, but can they escape?

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. Client: Starkey. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Look At Life Ups And Downs
programme.desc: 1964. A close look at the work of demolition men and how their jobs involve both knocking down and clearing away.

programme.title: Captain Pirate
programme.desc: 1952. Adventure. Directed by Ralph Murphy. Stars Louis Hayward, Patricia Medina & John Sutton. A retired buccaneer is forced back onto the high seas to escape execution and clear his good name.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Fish Hooks/Earthworm Farm. 1981. Jack visits A.E. Partridge & Sons, the last remaining fish hook maker in Redditch. Back home, he builds an earthworm farm to 'seed' his new patch of garden.

programme.title: The Great Game
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Diana Dors, Thora Hird & John Laurie. A wealthy chairman of Burnville United makes an unethical approach to a star player of another club.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A spectacular performance of Up On The Roof in this wonderful musical video from the 60s.

programme.title: Part-Time Wife
programme.desc: 1961. Comedy. Directed by Max Varnel. Stars Anton Rodgers, Nyree Dawn Porter & Kenneth J. Warren. A husband 'loans' his wife to his bachelor friend who needs to make a good impression.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Absence. 1974. Stars Christopher Burgess, Ian Cullen & Pauline Delaney. There's a bank raid on the cards and the only man who knows anything about it is Harry Dance.

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: 1954. Adventure. Directed by Tay Garnett. Stars Alan Ladd, Patricia Medina & Peter Cushing. A commoner disguises himself as the black knight to reveal those trying to overthrow King Arthur.

programme.title: Look At Life Down on the Farm
programme.desc: 1961. An in depth and intriguing look at the newest developments in farming of every kind.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Hit and Miss - Part 1. 1973. Stars T.P. McKenna & James Grout. A local businessman is accused of causing death by dangerous driving after a gardener was knocked from his bike and killed.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Hit and Miss - Part 2. 1973. Stars Frank Sieman, Charles Morgan & Derek Newark. Dr. Angus Roberts confirms where the paint specs at the crash came from, and Henry Burnett gives evidence.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Hit and Miss - Part 3. 1973. Stars Raymond Young, Ann Lynn & Peter Settelen. Henry Burnett's private secretary gives her employer an alibi, however, her husband breaks down under questioning.

programme.title: Music Unlimited
programme.desc: 1973. British music show featuring contemporary music acts of the time. Enjoy some rare performances from Heads, Hands and Feet, Julie Felix, Barry Ryan, Mary Hopkin and Lulu.

programme.title: Carrie's War
programme.desc: 2004. Drama. Director: Coky Giedroyc. Stars Alun Armstrong, Geraldine McEwan & Jack Stanley. Carrie and her brother are evacuated to Wales where they meet friends who make their time delightful.

programme.title: Look At Life At the End of a Rope
programme.desc: ...At the End of a Rope. 1963. A detailed look at the story of the rope and its many uses in the world of today.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Sent to Coventry. Stars Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Leslie is offered a promotion, but it means he, Ada and Ruth would have to move to Coventry. (S2, E03)

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Green for Danger. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Margaretta Scott. Mrs Osborne's emeralds have been stolen, and she wants them back. John Hunter tries to track the thief down.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Collector's Items. 1959. Stars Donald Gray, Teresa Thorne & Micheal Balfour. Shortly after eloping with a gold digging suitor, a wealthy woman is found murdered in a lonely cottage.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Happy Birthdays, Robert. 1981. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Roberts mothers cannot agree when he was born. Can Ida and Mrs Price become friends?

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 7. 1974. Eve Boswell sings One God and Sugar Bush. Fivepenny Piece perform Don't Wanna Go Home, and Gene Pitney sings Princess in Rags and Hello Mary Lou.

programme.title: The Comic

programme.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman

programme.title: Tufty Club Match Safety

programme.title: Out of Town

programme.title: Target Earth

programme.title: Behemoth The Seamonster

programme.title: Z-Cars

programme.title: Forbidden

programme.title: The Wicked Lady

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1982)
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

programme.title: The Weaker Sex
